If yes, split them into separate epics by priority so each can be planned independently. If the lower-priority HLR is incidental to the P0 work (error handling, doc coverage, config override that falls out of the same implementation) or is tightly coupled to the same implementation surface, keep it bundled — splitting tightly coupled work creates duplication and artificial boundaries. The row-level flag is what shows a reviewer the priority label was analyzed rather than collapsed; a rationale that lives only in a distant prose section does not.
